name: Dreamcatchers
overview: Scripture clearly forbids the making or worship of images and likenesses of anything in heaven, on earth, or under the earth, emphasizing God's desire for exclusive devotion without physical representations (Exodus 20:4; Deuteronomy 4:15). The Israelites were commanded to destroy all idols, images, and high places associated with pagan worship to avoid provoking God's anger through idolatry (Exodus 23:24; Numbers 33:52; Deuteronomy 32:16). In contrast, the gospel reveals God's love through the gift of His Son, offering salvation to all who believe, highlighting the sufficiency of Christ alone over any earthly symbols or talismans such as dreamcatchers (John 3:16).
